root_cause: The previous handoff invoked package-resident validators before the package commit had been merged into the preserved implementation branch. The branch therefore could not contain the required validator or authority documents.
controlling_rule: Bootstrap files are read from one externally pinned package commit with git show. Validate that exact commit in a detached temporary worktree, then merge that exact commit as second parent. No package-resident command is invoked from the preserved branch before the merge.

external_pin.source: PR #21 / GitHub branch readback / publication receipt

premerge_requirements: local branch, HEAD, tree, and clean status match the preserved fresh-review state
package SHA is a 40-hex commit and descends from package_minimum_ancestor
bootstrap manifest verifies every bootstrap payload byte
required WU-05 supplement, v3 schemas, canonicalization, validator, handoff, and prompt exist in the package commit
package validators pass in a detached temporary worktree before local history changes
prohibited: Codex branch creation, merge, rebase, reset, cherry-pick, amend, or force update
source mutation before every pre-repair marker passes
moving-ref merge without exact SHA pin
campaign rerun without solver-semantic or payload-byte change
production activation, timing or speedup claim, BDF ranking, tag, release, or merge
